items.title: Marvell Surges as China Ban Report Reignites Optical-Networking Stocks
items.summary: Marvell stock rises along with Corning, Lumentum and Coherent following a report about plans to restrict Chinese data-center components.

items.title: Corning Dropped 25% Over a Month: A Major U.S. Bank Expects 66% Gains Over The Near Term
items.summary: Corning just handed investors one of the steepest single-stock declines in its peer group, yet at least one major Wall Street bank is responding by raising its price target to levels that would shock most bears right now.

items.title: Palantir, AMD, Coherent, SpaceX, Caterpillar, Wayfair, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Palantir leads the S&P 500. Coherent and more AI names are rising sharply. SpaceX will issue its first earnings report after the closing bell Tuesday.

items.title: Today's Trade Is to Buy Chips and Sell the Magnificent 7
items.summary: The tech stock rally continued, extending yesterday's gains, but today's rise looks a little different. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite was up 1.1%. The tech sector led the S&P 500, up 3.1%. Unlike yesterday, it wasn't the Magnificent Seven stocks doing the heavy lifting.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Rockets 17%, Coherent Climbs 11%, Lumentum Gains 6% on Reported U.S. Ban of Chinese Optics
items.summary: A reported U.S. ban on Chinese data center optical hardware sent a handful of domestic suppliers rocketing higher, but the proposal is still a draft and could be softened or dropped entirely before the year-end enforcement target.

items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

items.title: Coherent Stock Jumps 14% on Potential Chinese Ban Report
items.summary: Zhongji Innolight holds 27% of the global data center transceiver market

items.title: Optical component stocks rally on proposed U.S. ban on Chinese tech
items.summary: U.S. optical component stocks surged following a Reuters report that the Trump administration is drafting a ban on U.S. imports of new Chinese data center hardware. Applied Optoelectronics jumped 16%, Coherent gained 13%, Lumentum rose 11%, and Corning climbed 8%. According to four sources familiar with the matter, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is preparing restrictions against new Chinese optical transceivers—the critical hardware that routes data over fiber-optic cables inside AI
